metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It reads the JSON request from `--input`, writes the JSON response to `--output`, supports `inspect` and `render`, and validates the LAS 1.4 header, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats `0` through `10`, waveform-related metadata, and extra-bytes metadata. Malformed or contradictory recognized `LASF_Spec` and `LASF_Projection` records are treated as document errors, not downgraded to opaque payloads.

`cmake -B build /workspace/output && cmake --build build` succeeds. I also smoke-tested a format-6 WKT render/inspect round-trip, a format-4 round-trip with the waveform object omitted so zero waveform fields are written, and explicit failure cases for both `invalid_request` and `invalid_document`.
